agents.instruction: Extract the absolute value after `Verification config (absolute):` from the complete workflow input. Return exactly one raw JSON object with verificationConfig and projectRoot. Preserve both paths exactly. Do not read files, merge, verify, install or deploy.
agents.name: Verification Request Router

agents.instruction: Load and deterministically validate the selected verification_input.json. Return its exact normalized fields and diagnostics without changing them.
agents.name: Load Verification Input

agents.instruction: Inspect the validated verification input. Require non-empty projectRoot, configPath, promptsFile, outputFile, subjectContext, acceptanceCriteria, master, at least one adapter and output. Require weights to be empty or contain exactly one value for the master plus one per adapter. Require output to differ from every input. When bootstrapRequired=true, require exactly one trained adapter; the deterministic merge tool will seed the absent master from it without scaling. Return exactly one raw JSON object with ready (Boolean) and missingPrerequisites (array of strings). Do not call tools.
agents.name: Verification Merge Readiness Inspector

agents.instruction: Prepare the verification candidate from the validated file inputs. If the master is absent, atomically bootstrap it from the single trained adapter without scaling; otherwise create a new non-in-place merge candidate. Preserve the exact returned adapter path, provenance report and diagnostics.
agents.name: Candidate Merge Runner

agents.instruction: Verify only the adapter path returned by Candidate Merge Runner against the held-out prompt file loaded from verification_input.json.
agents.name: Merged Candidate Verification Runner

properties.description: Merged adapter supplied only by Candidate Merge Runner.

agents.instruction: Review the real merged-candidate verification output against subjectContext and acceptanceCriteria from the validated file. Apply explicit runtime rules for documented variants, contradictory sources, tolerated cross-documentation and uncertainty before classifying cross-context contamination. Mixed terminology alone is not a failure when the runtime context permits it. Still reject invented identifiers, values or transport-specific behavior unsupported by the permitted sources. Inspect every held-out case. Return exactly one raw JSON object with decision (PASS, FAIL or INCONCLUSIVE), findings (array) and reportPaths (array). Process success or keyword matches alone are insufficient. Never call tools.
agents.name: Merged Candidate Evidence Reviewer

agents.instruction: Produce the final operator report. Lead with exactly one decision: PASS, FAIL or INCONCLUSIVE. Identify the selected verification config, merge inputs, merged candidate, merge report, verification report, prompt coverage, findings and blockers. Never claim installation or update occurred.
agents.name: Verification Merge Gate Synthesizer

connections.condition: Review real verification output or failure diagnostics.
connections.label: Review verification evidence

goal: Load one generated verification_input.json, bootstrap an absent master or create a reversible merged candidate, verify that exact returned adapter and return an evidence-backed release decision without deploying.
name: finetune_master_verification_workflow
summary: Uses one selected verification config file to bootstrap a missing master or drive a non-in-place merge, then verifies the exact returned adapter and independently reviews it.
systemInstruction: Treat product and domain details only as runtime data loaded by finetune_load_verification_input. A completely absent master is atomically seeded from the single trained adapter; an existing master produces a new merge candidate directory. Verify only the adapter returned by the merge tool. Never infer PASS from process success and never install or update LM Studio.
